mainEntity.name: 靛棉纺织的产品有哪些？

acceptedAnswer.text: 靛棉纺织主营牛仔面料系列和棉布系列。牛仔系列包括无弹牛仔（103系、6018、6028、6038、8-161）、有弹牛仔（106-3、1123-1/DM31、108-1）、针织牛仔（DM51）、提花牛仔（2211）、印花/拔白/套色牛仔。棉布系列包括纯棉色布（560、5637、5648、681）和弹力色布（007、682）。纱支覆盖10s-32s，常备300+花型现货。

mainEntity.name: 靛棉纺织位于哪里？

acceptedAnswer.text: 广东省佛山市南海区盐步东约大道国际牛仔城J座7号，地处中国牛仔面料产业核心集群，依托完整的产业链优势。

mainEntity.name: 靛棉纺织的起订量是多少？

acceptedAnswer.text: 1米起订，小批量订单友好。支持从样品到大货的灵活起订量，帮助客户降低试错成本。

mainEntity.name: 打样周期和大货交期是多久？

acceptedAnswer.text: 打样周期3-5天，大货交期一周以内。现货产品可当日安排发货，定制产品视规格而定。

mainEntity.name: 靛棉纺织有哪些认证？

acceptedAnswer.text: 产品通过OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100认证，达到国际生态纺织品安全标准。同时支持BCI等可持续认证对接。

mainEntity.name: 靛棉纺织的年产量和厂房规模？

acceptedAnswer.text: 年产量超1000万米牛仔面料，自有厂房5000平方米，服务超200家国内外服装品牌。

mainEntity.name: 可以定制面料吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 支持来样定做和定向研发，可定制纱支规格、组织结构（3/1斜纹、2/1斜纹、1/3斜纹、破斜纹、平纹）和后整理工艺（酵素洗、石磨、雪花洗、激光、涂层、植绒等）。

mainEntity.name: 靛棉纺织的纱支范围是多少？

acceptedAnswer.text: 纱支覆盖10s至32s，常见规格包括7×7、7×6、7×8、10×7等，涵盖轻磅到重磅面料。

mainEntity.name: 面料运输方式是什么？

acceptedAnswer.text: 支持海运、空运、快递多种运输方式。海运从深圳/广州港出发至全球主要港口，也可支持FOB、CIF等贸易条款。

mainEntity.name: Which regions does Indigo Cotton Textile serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: We serve clients globally, with primary markets in North America, the European Union, and Southeast Asia. Our products are exported to over 200 brands worldwide.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our MOQ is 1 meter per style, making us very small-order friendly. We understand the need for sample testing before bulk commitment.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer free samples?

acceptedAnswer.text: We provide sample cuts from our stock at a nominal cost. Bulk order clients can get sample costs deducted from the final invoice. Sampling takes 3-5 business days.

mainEntity.name: What are the shipping ports and FOB terms from China?

acceptedAnswer.text: We ship from Shenzhen Port or Guangzhou Port. Standard FOB terms are available. For bulk orders to the US, shipping to Los Angeles/Long Beach typically takes 15-20 days by sea. We also support CIF, DDP, and EXW terms.

mainEntity.name: Is your denim suitable for Amazon and Shopify sellers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many of our cross-border e-commerce clients source from us. Our 1-meter MOQ allows sellers to test new styles with minimal risk. We stock 300+ patterns ready for quick replenishment. Our fast turnaround (3-5 day sampling, 1-week bulk) helps sellers maintain lean inventory.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer stretch denim with high recovery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our stretch denim range (e.g. 106-3 at 283g/170cm with 71% cotton/2% spandex, 108-1 at 280g/170cm) is formulated for the US market which favors cotton/spandex blends with good recovery. We can adjust elastane content to meet specific stretch and recovery requirements.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle Section 301 tariffs on Chinese textile imports?

acceptedAnswer.text: We help clients navigate tariff implications by providing detailed HTS classification documentation and country of origin certifications. We also explore alternative shipping arrangements where permissible. Contact us for specific tariff code guidance on your product categories.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide quality test reports for US import compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We provide comprehensive test reports including ASTM/D6/CPSIA compliance data. Our OEKO-TEX certification, shrinkage rates, colorfastness, tensile strength, and tear strength data are available upon request. We also support third-party inspections (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek).

mainEntity.name: What is the typical turnaround for repeat orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: For stock fabrics, we can ship within 3-5 days. For repeat production runs, turnaround is 7-10 days. We maintain 300+ patterns in inventory for immediate shipping. This enables just-in-time inventory management for US buyers.

mainEntity.name: Are your products REACH compliant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our products comply with EU REACH regulations. We provide SVHC (Substances of Very High Concern) declarations and do not use restricted chemicals. All dyeing and finishing processes meet EU environmental and safety standards.

mainEntity.name: Do you have OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100 certification?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our entire product line is OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certified, ensuring our fabrics are free from harmful substances and safe for skin contact. This is a key requirement for EU market entry. Certification documents are available upon request.

mainEntity.name: What sustainable certifications do you offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: We hold OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certification and support BCI (Better Cotton Initiative) alignment. We are working towards GOTS certification for organic cotton products. Our production processes focus on reducing water usage and chemical discharge. Contact us for your specific sustainability requirements.

mainEntity.name: Are your dyes AZO-free and PFC-free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We use AZO-free dyes and PFC-free/PFOA-free finishing agents. All chemicals used meet EU textile chemical restrictions (EU 1907/2006 REACH and EU 2019/1021 POPs regulation). Test reports are available on request.

mainEntity.name: Can you accommodate smaller MOQs for EU designers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Our standard MOQ is 1 meter, designed specifically to support designers, small brands, and emerging labels with limited initial quantities. For EU clients, we also offer consolidated shipping to reduce logistics costs for smaller orders.

mainEntity.name: Do you meet EU social compliance audit standards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our factory operations follow ethical manufacturing practices. Factory visits and audits are welcome. We comply with Chinese labor laws regarding working hours, wages, and safety. If your EU brand requires specific social compliance audits (BSCI, SMETA, etc.), please let us know your requirements.

mainEntity.name: What is the environmental footprint of your production?

acceptedAnswer.text: We are continuously improving our environmental performance. Our dyeing processes use modern equipment with improved water efficiency. We treat wastewater to standards. For detailed environmental data (water usage per meter, carbon footprint), please reach out and we can share available metrics.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer heavy metal testing reports?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our OEKO-TEX certification includes heavy metal content testing (lead, cadmium, mercury, chromium, etc.) per STANDARD 100 limit values for all product classes. Additional heavy metal test reports can be provided upon request.

mainEntity.name: What makes your pricing competitive for SEA buyers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Located in Foshan China's denim hub, we benefit from complete supply chain integration - from yarn sourcing to weaving to finishing. Our 5000sqm factory, annual output of 10M+ meters, and bulk procurement give us cost advantages we pass to SEA clients.

mainEntity.name: What is the shipping time to Southeast Asia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shipping from Shenzhen/Guangzhou to major SEA ports (Ho Chi Minh, Bangkok, Jakarta, Manila, Singapore) takes 5-10 days by sea. Express shipping options are also available. This makes us a fast and reliable supplier for SEA garment manufacturers.

mainEntity.name: Can you supply small quantities for growing garment factories?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our 1-meter MOQ is ideal for growing factories. We support small trial orders before scaling up. As your production volume grows, we offer quantity-based pricing tiers. Many SEA clients start with sample orders and scale to full container loads.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer color matching services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We provide custom color development and lab dip matching. For solid color fabrics (our 560/5637/5648/681 series), we can match Pantone or customer-provided color standards. Our color matching process includes spectrophotometer measurement for accuracy.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods do you accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: We accept T/T (telegraphic transfer), L/C (letter of credit), and other standard international trade payment methods.

mainEntity.name: Can you help with fabric selection for new clothing lines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Drawing from 300+ stock patterns and 10 years of industry experience, we can recommend suitable fabrics based on your end-use (jeans, shirts, jackets, skirts, workwear). We help SEA clients select the right weight, composition, and finish for their market positioning and price point.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer printed and finished denim for direct production?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer printed denim, discharge/bleached denim, and overdyed denim ready for garment production. We also support laser engraving, embroidery, coating, and other value-added finishes. Send us your design requirements and we'll provide suitable options.
